piece_strategy.mode: deterministic source crops or clip masks
piece_strategy.egg: Mask the upper egg above the wordmark contour. Treat source bounds as guides, not a rectangular mask that cuts through lettering. Copy only pixels wholly outside the wordmark.
piece_strategy.wordmark: A stationary base uses complementary masks so moving pieces are not duplicated at their original positions. Keep the entire NANOBEASTS / EVOLVE band fixed from initial reveal through final hold.
piece_strategy.shards: At most 4 floating source shard accents, using tightly matched polygons outside the lettering; 4–7 px outward/upward displacement and 1–2 degrees rotation, then reset. No fabricated crystal art.
piece_strategy.reassembly: At 0.833333 s, the original full logo alone is visible at identity transform; hide piece copies and glow overlays to avoid seams or doubling.
piece_strategy.fallback: If clean masks cannot be achieved quickly, use intact logo reveal with localized crack pulse; omit independent egg/shard motion rather than distort artwork.
